69:t_2:77.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Sorry I kept you waiting, $$レド$$, $$ベベル$$. ...Did something happen?」

69:t_2:79.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Yeah... The hot plate seems to be acting up.」

69:t_3:3.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...$$ガロード$$ and the others really are leaving...」

69:t_3:7.en:
$$ベベル$$
「It's not that I'm tired of life on the fleet...」

69:t_3:8.en:
$$ベベル$$
「But if there's a big world I don't know beyond this sea... I thought I'd like to see it...」

69:t_3:10.en:
$$ベベル$$
「You'd like to see it too, wouldn't you, Sis?」

69:t_3:12.en:
$$ベベル$$
「...Sis... If you find something you really want to do, don't worry about me, okay?」

69:t_3:14.en:
$$ベベル$$
「Oh... Look, I think the meat's cooked.」

69:t_3:15.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You're right. Did they fix... the plate?」

70:t_000:1.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「So, to celebrate the fleet being safe, say goodbye to $$ガロード$$ and $c, and enjoy our day off on this calm day... All in one...」

70:t_000:2.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「We're having a barbecue party!」

70:t_001:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Our stay was brief, but thank you for all your help.」

70:t_001:1.en:
$$リジット$$
「No... We should be thanking you.」

70:t_001:2.en:
$$リジット$$
「Meeting all of you... has given me a lot to think about.」

70:t_001:4.en:
$$リジット$$
「As the Fleet Commander's aide, I've always put living as a resident of the $$残されの海$$ first.」

70:t_001:5.en:
$$リジット$$
「But meeting you has made me curious about what's beyond this sea.」

70:t_001:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Then you're leaving the $$残されの海$$?」

70:t_001:7.en:
$$リジット$$
「I haven't made any plans that definite.」

70:t_001:8.en:
$$リジット$$
「But someday... I've started thinking about it, just a little.」

70:t_001:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Nothing binds you here. Treasure your freedom to decide where your voyage takes you.」

70:t_002:0.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Are you really leaving, $$ガロード$$?」

70:t_002:1.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「We only just became friends with $$ティファ$$ and $$パーラ$$, too.」

70:t_002:2.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I'm sorry, $$メルティ$$, $$サーヤ$$...」

70:t_002:4.en:
$$メルティ$$
「To fight $$サイデリアル$$?」

70:t_002:5.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Yeah... And I'm worried about our old friends who've been separated from us, too.」

70:t_002:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't worry so much. We beat the pirates and the $$サイデリアル$$ forces around here.」

70:t_002:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Besides, $$レド$$ will probably stay with the fleet in my place.」

70:t_002:9.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Hey...! That's not the treatment I got when I joined the fleet!」

70:t_002:10.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「Hehe... Well, you only had eyes for $$ティファ$$ from the start, $$ガロード$$.」

70:t_002:12.en:
$$メルティ$$
「We'll see you again, right, $$ティファ$$?」

70:t_002:14.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「It's too bad you can't be at the festival, but we already got the outfits ready... Next time you're here, let's all four dance together.」

70:t_002:15.en:
$$ティファ$$
「Thank you, $$サーヤ$$, $$メルティ$$.」

70:t_002:16.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Speaking of which, where's $$エイミー$$?」

70:t_002:17.en:
$$ティファ$$
「She's in the shade over there with $$レド$$ and $$ベベル$$.」

70:t_003:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...I question the necessity of this situation.」

70:t_003:1.en:
$$アル$$
「Weren't you listening? This party is for everyone.」

70:t_003:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I question whether this unit's presence is necessary.」

70:t_003:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Then would you rather have stayed behind in a dark hangar?」

70:t_003:4.en:
$$アル$$
「I, for one, would find being left out like that unbearable.」

70:t_003:5.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Question. What does 'left out' mean?」

70:t_003:6.en:
$$アル$$
「...This is a good opportunity. I'll answer your question with something I've always wanted to say.」

70:t_003:7.en:
$$アル$$
「Think for yourself... is my answer.」

70:t_003:9.en:
$$アル$$
「But aren't you glad you came? It's rare to see the Sergeant smile when he usually looks so gloomy.」

70:t_003:10.en:
$$アル$$
「Watching everyone enjoying themselves is also quite fascinating. ...Isn't it, $$オックス$$?」

70:t_003:13.en:
$$アル$$
「As an Enlightenment Interface, shouldn't you also supervise Ensign $$レド$$'s activities?」

70:t_003:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Acknowledged. I will begin supervising Ensign $$レド$$'s activities.」

70:t_003:15.en:
$$アル$$
「You're so stiff. No wonder they call you a tin can...」

70:t_004:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Damn it...! What's wrong with this plate...? It's not nearly hot enough!」

70:t_004:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Hurry up and fix it, $$ピニオン$$. You're a repairman, aren't you?」

70:t_004:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Make it quick. There's a whole crowd waiting for the meat to cook.」

70:t_004:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$甲児$$, how about cooking it all at once with Breast Fire?」

70:t_004:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「No way...! It wouldn't just burn black, it'd go up in smoke instantly!」

70:t_004:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Excessive power does have its drawbacks.」

70:t_004:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you've figured that out, stop planting explosives all over town and at school!」

70:t_004:7.en:
$$アル$$
「$$ピニオン$$, I have just the thing for cooking meat.」

70:t_004:9.en:
$$アル$$
「Is that what you call someone who offers you useful information?」

70:t_004:10.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Sorry. So, what's this perfect thing you've got?」

70:t_004:12.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Oh! Yeah, that could work!」

70:t_004:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I cannot comprehend... I request an explanation of the situation.」

70:t_004:14.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Shut up with all that yammering. Someone bring me some fat!」

70:t_005:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「All right! The meat's ready, everyone!」
